item.title: Rallying Cry – August 3, 2026
item.description: Glasgow’s Commonwealth Games handover to Amdavad is a win for teamwork, parents and students are celebrating victories over unfair school policies, a Spanish farmer found her donkeys alive after wildfires, and a promising malaria vaccine trial is underway!
